Hub/System/Icons
System

Icons.

The one icon page. Three sets, all current (R-35): the capsule icons, one glyph in the logo capsule, lying or standing, are the website's working set for rows, cards and menus; the 12 drawn feature icons stay for larger moments; the 46 UI glyphs sit in buttons, fields and the portal. Every icon is Deep Teal on light grounds, never Navy, never Yellow, and every placed size has its own file so the line renders at 1.5 or more (R-109).

SizesFeature iconsUI iconsCapsule iconsAll subjectsDesktop and mobileRulesDownloadsIcon colourIcon motionOpen items

Feature icons.

12 drawn icons for larger moments: a hero point, a feature band, an empty state (R-35). 64 grid, 1.5 stroke, round caps, no fill, Deep Teal, the capsule drawn with the logo's true proportions and the divider (R-105, R-109). Placed at 64 on desktop and 48 on mobile; the 48 file is its own export (assets/icons/sized/) so the line still renders at 1.5. Files in assets/icons/, made sized by make_icon_sizes.py.

Current · R-35

The capsule in all 12 files has the logo's true proportions (long half on top, short half wider) and keeps the divider; details that the divider would cut sit in one half. Figma still draws this set in Navy, a logo colour (R-84): the Figma clean-up recolours it to Deep Teal.

Sizes, per family.

Decided (R-35, U-27; one file per placed size, U-31). The stroke floor of 1.5 applies to the line as it renders (R-109), so a file is never scaled down: each placed size has its own export with a thicker drawing stroke that renders at 1.5. Use the file named for the size.

Never smaller than these sizes on any screen. A feature icon below 48 or a capsule icon below 40 × 20 is the wrong family: use a UI glyph.

UI icons.

One set of 46 working icons for buttons, fields, rows and the portal: 20 grid, 1.75 stroke, round caps and joins, no fill, currentColor, never Yellow (R-35). Files in assets/icons/ui/.

Current

One set on the 20 grid with a 1.75 stroke (--size-icon-glyph-grid, --size-icon-glyph-stroke); there is no second set at 24 / 1.5. "My treatment" uses the capsule glyph, the logo's true shape with the divider. Settings uses the gear.

Capsule icons, lying and standing.

The website's working set (R-35, U-27). One subject glyph sits in the long half of the logo capsule, where "unified" sits in the seal; the short half stays open. Every icon comes lying flat like the logo (horizontal) and standing (the same capsule turned 90 degrees clockwise, long half on top).

Current · R-35

12 subjects, two glyph options each (A and B), two orientations, two variants: 96 master files plus one export per placed size, made by make_capsule_icons.py from the capsule generator (R-105). To confirm Only one thing is open: A or B for each subject.

Stroke 1.5 as rendered, round caps and joins, as the 12 feature icons. R-109: 0.85% of a 60 or 56 long capsule is 0.5, so the 1.5 minimum applies, and the divider stays, like the seal, as it does at every size. The sized exports thicken the drawing stroke (2 at 48 × 24, 2.4 at 40 × 20, 2 at standing 48) so the rendered line is 1.5. Keylines in Pastel Blue on these two sheets only. The horizontal tile is 2:1 so it stays on the 8px grid (48 × 24, 40 × 20) and its height matches a line of text (24 for body, 20 for labels); the capsule itself is 2.79:1, so it keeps equal air above and below.

LineCapsule outline and glyph in Deep Teal, no fill. For light grounds: lists, rows, inline text.
ContainerBoth halves in Wash Blue with a 1.5 gap at the divider (as rendered), glyph in Deep Teal. For cards, tiles and dark grounds.

Twelve subjects, two options each.

Each row: horizontal line, horizontal container, standing line, standing container, shown at 48 × 24 and 48. The glyphs are drawn for these icons; none shows a body, a pill count or a result.

Rules for capsule icons.

Current: they spell out R-35 (U-27) and R-109 for this family.

TopicRule
ShapeThe capsule in every icon is the logo capsule from tools/capsule_svg.py: long half 55% of the length, short half taller. Never a symmetric pill, never redrawn by hand.
OrientationHorizontal: the capsule lies flat, long half on the left, like the logo. Standing: turned 90 degrees clockwise, long half on top. Use the file for each orientation; never rotate a file, because the glyph turns with it.
Horizontal is for linesList and table rows, menu and navigation rows, steps in a row, chips and tags, inline in a sentence.
Standing is for blocksCard grids, feature tiles, app-style tiles, empty states, the top of a modal.
One kind per groupA list, a row or a grid uses one orientation and one variant. Never mix horizontal with standing, line with container, or option A with option B.
GlyphOne glyph in a 13 × 13 cell, centred in the long half. The short half stays empty. Nothing crosses the divider or leaves the capsule. No letters or numbers inside (R-33), except the Rx mark.
Stroke1.5 as rendered (R-109), round caps and joins, no fill on lines, as the 12 feature icons. Each placed size has its own file; never scale a file up or down, and never change the stroke by hand.
Desktop sizesHorizontal 48 × 24 in rows and inline (file -48x24); standing 64 in cards (the master or -64).
Mobile sizesHorizontal 40 × 20 in rows and inline (file -40x20); standing 48 in cards (file -48). Never smaller than 40 × 20 or 48 on any screen.
ProportionThe horizontal tile is always 2:1, the standing tile always square. Never stretch, squash or crop an icon.
ColourLine: Deep Teal. Container: Wash Blue halves, Deep Teal glyph. On Deep Teal grounds use the container, or the line icon inlined in Paper (see Icon colour). Never Yellow, never Coral, never a logo colour (R-84), never a product colour.
SpacingIcon to label: 16 in desktop rows, 12 in mobile rows, 8 inline. Standing icon to card title: 16 on both. Nothing else inside the tile.
AlignmentIn a row the tile is centred on the first line of its label. Inline, the tile height matches the line height and uses vertical-align: middle, so the capsule centre sits half an x-height above the baseline. In a card the standing icon aligns to the text column's left edge (or its centre when the card is centred).
Tap targetsAn icon is never a control on its own. The whole row or card is the target: at least 44 tall, 56 for mobile list rows.
ButtonsNot in buttons: a button carries one 20px UI glyph (R-100). A capsule icon never replaces a label.
AccessibilityAlways next to visible words, so the icon is decorative: alt="" or aria-hidden="true".
FilesMasters {subject}-{a|b}-{horizontal|standing}-{line|container}.svg; placed sizes in sized/ with -48x24, -40x20, -64 or -48 added. Made by the generator only.
Do: horizontal in a row.
Centred on the label, 16 apart.
Don't: rotate a horizontal file.
The glyph lies on its side. Use the standing file.
Do: one orientation per group.
Don't: mix orientations or variants.
Do: container on Deep Teal.

The Wash Blue halves carry the Deep Teal glyph on dark grounds.

Don't: Yellow, Coral or a symmetric pill.

Yellow is the one CTA per viewport, Coral marks errors, and the capsule always has the logo's shape.

Icon colour.

For every icon set on this page: which icon colour goes on which ground. Contrast is the icon against its ground; icons need at least 3:1 (WCAG non-text contrast). Ratios are computed from tokens.json.

Current · R-35

Deep Teal is the icon colour on every light ground, Paper on Deep Teal (U-27). The 12 drawn feature icons are Deep Teal, files included. On Deep Teal, line icons are used as inline SVG with currentColor set to Paper; the files themselves are Deep Teal.

One accent per section (R-115): a line icon may take Green or Blue where the section adds a brand accent, on Paper only, where it passes 3:1. Everything else stays Deep Teal.

Don't: Yellow icons.
1.6:1 on Paper, and Yellow is the one CTA per viewport.
Don't: a container on Wash Blue.
The halves disappear into the ground. Use the line icon.
Don't: Deep Teal on Deep Teal.
The Deep Teal file on a dark ground. Inline it in Paper or use the container.
Don't: Navy or a product colour.
Navy is a logo colour (R-84); product colours mark products only.

Mobile: the same pairs. On phones the matrix shows one ground per block, two icon types per line. Coral stays for UI error glyphs only (alert-circle, alert-triangle), always with words.

Icon motion.

Motion confirms, it never performs (R-49). Icons move only to confirm something the visitor did or to show a section arriving. Durations and easing are the motion tokens (R-50, R-51); with reduced motion every demo shows its end state at once.

Proposed

Icon motion is a proposal inside the motion system (Motion). Live demos, pure CSS and SVG, tokens only. Shown at 2x so the motion reads; real sizes are the ones in the rules above. A small script only replays the demos.

  1. One move per icon, once. Nothing loops except the loader (R-53).
  2. Only the icon moves. The label beside it never animates on its own.
  3. The shape stays true. Halves may draw, close or fill, but the capsule keeps the logo's proportions at every frame.
  4. Reduced motion: the tokens drop to 0ms and every icon shows its end state; the loader shows a still half fill.
  5. Mobile: no hover, so no lift; enter motion starts when 40% of the icon is visible.
